7 years I have decided to leave this practice due to the lack of competence, communication and care I have experienced.

Communication
1.	Their phone line only accepts a low number of callers so does not acknowledge the order that patients have called in. This means you get a busy tone and have to repeatedly press redial until you luck out and get through– my record was 400 times.
2.	There is no pathway to contact relevant staff in the practice, and all queries have to be funnelled through reception.
3.	They don’t chase up follow up appointments and treatments you need.

Competence
4.	The staff seemed poorly trained and make and repeat careless mistakes. For example,
a.	Removing all my prescriptions without warning, and then taking 4 months to put them back on.
b.	Prescribing me medicine I am allergic to in the same appointment about a hospital referral for my allergies.
c.	Uploading someone else's medical records into my referral letter and mine onto theirs, then taking no action until REPEATED chasing from me.
d.	Trying to triage me to see a Nurse rather than a Doctor because they don't have adequate medical knowledge i.e. facial myokymia is not a "skin condition".
e.	Telling me to make an appointment, and then at the appointment asking me why I have asked for an appointment.
f.	Asking me to have a test then not putting it on my record so no one knows what test I need.
5.	A poor understanding of GDPR practice and protocols.
6.	Some of my records have so many spelling and grammatical errors I can’t even read what they say.

Care
7.	The majority of the reception staff are rude and unhelpful. I just don’t know why you do this job if you hate people.
8.	Nothing they do is to make anything easier for you.
9.	Constantly lying: i.e.
o	I was promised on multiple occasions that staff would contact me back (such as the Practice Manager), and it never happened until I chased them up.
o	Inconsistencies in policy – one person tells you, you can’t make in advance appointments and you have 2 call up at 8am to make one, and another time you are given an appointment in advance…
10.	I’ve never seen the same doctor twice, so no one know you, your history and it doesn’t feel like anyone is looking after you.
11.	Saying things that are worrying or careless, i.e.:
o	“Wow your bleeding like crazy”
o	“There’s no point in telling me, I’m not a clinician, I’m not who you should be speaking to” (when calling reception, which is the only place to call and the only person you are allowed to speak to...)

It’s hard to write any kind of balance into this review because I feel so harmed from the experience of being here, and this list is just the tip of the iceberg. There are significant problems with the NHS, so not all of the issues I have outlined are probably solely this practice’s fault, but regardless I would not recommend this place to anyone and it’s been a horrible experience using this service.",null,[0,125]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25CeE9HaElTakpTVmsxVWJHNXRWRW96UTJsMlpYYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xbe5a1da6f3a1e6b1!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnBxOGhISjJSVk1UbG5tVEozQ2l2ZXc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25CeE9HaElTakpTVmsxVWJHNXRWRW96UTJsMlpYYxAB&t=1&-KgswY2w1SUQyemlpNQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiPnrbf9rOTAxUjAXsEHc1uBKcQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwiPnrbf9rOTAxUjAXsEHc1uBKcQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMkpCTVdwelRWOWZSV2hCYkc5elNXcFljRTlHWWtSVlJrTlBNRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpXWjBOYWMwUlhUM2QzV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWQlJIQk9ja2h3YkRGZmRUSXhkREZGZGxOdExYYxAB",["0x0:0xbe5a1da6f3a1e6b1",null,1757671459861927,1757671459861927,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/100187340038126800583/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Miriam McCann","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLf0YpipFYgve54u2LzZwxsUvhWOaFD5EBfzL8pAV05My-5bQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/100187340038126800583?hl=en"],"100187340038126800583",null,15,0,null,[0,3,1],1,["15 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiPnrbf9rOTAxUjAXsEHc1uBKcQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"6 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Rang yesterday at around 10.30am  and asked for appointment or phone appointment for Urine Infection as in pain.
